## Tuesday, June 9

We talked about the project!

### To Dos for next time

Read/skim all/some of the readings, with an eye towards type of institutions you'd be most interested in scraping/collecting data about. By this, I mean museums, monuments, statues, businesses, satellite, etc., not work, religious, art, war, etc. Can start to think about where you would get that type of data/how you would collect.

### Ian

Interest: public libraries, sport venues, open source map of 1,300 arenas and stadiums. Industrial businesses (corporate buildings, power plants, GIS data on power plants). Concert halls and symphony halls

Narrow scope to three things you are interested in, and start thinking more logistically about collecting data
